purpose: Exact symbolic derivations covering the universal phase and regular-simplex/economy quantifiers. Finite numerical sweeps are corroboration, not the proof.

assumptions.claim1: real phase projections; shared translation; complex Fourier features with conjugate query/key phases
assumptions.claim2: integer n>=2 for the paper's n-dimensional simplex; rho>1 and resolution>1 for the economy objective

claim1.translation_identity: R(a+t)^T R(b+t) = R(b-a) for arbitrary real a,b,t

claim2.tight_frame: sum_i v_i v_i^T=((n+1)/n)I on the zero-sum subspace
